15 San Jose hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Which booking site listed the lowest prices for San Jose hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 15 San Jose hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 8, KAYAK.com at 2, Super.com at 2 and trivago DEALS at 2. These are the San Jose rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 15 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 9, Etrip.net at 8, goseek.com at 5, KAYAK.com at 3, Hotelscombined.com at 2, momondo.com at 2, Super.com at 2, Billabook.com at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them (a tie counts for each site). The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Taxes and fees at San Jose hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 17% ($28 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at The Domain Hotel Sunnyvale to 17% at Spark by Hilton San Jose Airport. At 1 hotel the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
